_comment: Street addresses for MAIN, permanent concert venues, used ONLY for the schema.org Event 'location.address' (clears the Search Console 'Missing field streetAddress' warning). Key = normalised venue name (lowercase, accents stripped, non-alphanumerics -> space); matched as an exact normalised name or a prefix of it. A venue NOT listed keeps the old city-only address, so a missing entry is harmless. A WRONG address is worse than none: add only venues whose address was confirmed and that do not move. Deliberately left out: hotel rooms, municipal rooms, and Clarence Jazz Club (it moved to Torremolinos). Added 2026-10-04 (Sofia).
